description: This file defines the IGrainReferenceRuntime interface within the Orleans runtime, specifying methods for invoking grain methods asynchronously or synchronously, and casting grains to specific interfaces.

methods.name: InvokeMethodAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously invokes a method on a grain, returning a ValueTask with the result.

methods.name: InvokeMethodAsync
methods.description: Invokes a method on a grain without returning a value, asynchronously.

methods.name: InvokeMethod
methods.description: Invokes a void method on a grain without waiting for a response.

methods.name: Cast
methods.description: Converts a grain to a specified interface type.
